campaign_subtitle: The Scarcity of the Outer Rim
campaign_logline: A desperate pilot navigates a dying industrial sector where every scrap of metal is worth its weight in fuel.
campaign_pitch: You are a debt-ridden pilot. Zenith and Aurelia fight over shrinking mineral rights. You haul cargo to survive the week. A massive supply chain collapse threatens local stability.
campaign_story_summary: A struggling pilot takes contracts from Kaelen. A Reaver ship is intercepted near a mining hub. The strike causes a localized fuel shortage. Zenith and Aurelia clash over remaining reserves. You find encrypted logs about manufacturing shortages. A hidden economic rot eats the sector's trade. Act 1 focuses on securing local supply lines.
tone: Dry, cynical, and gritty industrial sci-fi.

opening.status_quo: The mining hubs are failing due to aging infrastructure.
opening.visible_crisis: Fuel shortages have made transport routes dangerous.
opening.hidden_crisis: A systemic manufacturing collapse is hollowing out the market.
opening.why_now: Current reserves are critically low for the next cycle.
opening.player_role: An independent pilot with a failing ship.

mystery.question: Why is the industrial output dropping so sharply?
mystery.false_answer: The equipment is simply too old to maintain.
mystery.true_answer_hint: Manufacturing hubs are being intentionally sabotaged by a shadow entity.
mystery.long_term_reveal_direction: The sabotage is part of a larger corporate dismantling plan.

kaelen.secret_angle: She tracks the flow of essential resources to predict market crashes.
kaelen.address_rule: Always refer to her as Kaelen.
kaelen.never_reveal_rule: Her origin or true motives remain unknown.

factions.zenith_problem: Zenith demands priority for industrial manufacturing components.
factions.aurelia_problem: Aurelia insists on stabilizing orbital trade routes.
factions.vanguard_problem: Vanguard faces constant supply line disruptions.
factions.conflict_triangle: Resource scarcity forces three factions to corner the market.
factions.neutral_space_pressure: Independent traders are squeezed by rising fuel costs.

act_1.name: The Scarcity Cycle
act_1.goal: Secure enough parts for a local refinery.
act_1.opening_incident: A Reaver ship is intercepted near the main gate.
act_1.midpoint_turn: You discover that the haul was stolen from Aurelia.
act_1.finale: The local refinery is stabilized by your delivery.
act_1.player_takeaway: Survival depends on choosing which faction's cargo is prioritized.

starter_mission.title: Scrap of the Scarcity
starter_mission.reason: A Reaver ship carrying vital fuel components must be neutralized.
starter_mission.enemy_knows: The Reaver is desperate for scrap and will fight aggressively.
starter_mission.after_effect: You recover the cargo and receive your first payment.

recurring_clue.name: The Shortage Log
recurring_clue.signal: Encrypted data packets in derelict hulls.
recurring_clue.first_appearance: Found inside the Reaver ship's core.
recurring_clue.escalation: More logs appear as you visit more mining hubs.
recurring_clue.payoff_hint: The logs reveal a pattern of intentional sabotage.

rumor_trail.name: The Ghost Refinery
rumor_trail.hint_theme: Abandoned industrial sites and illegal trade.
clue_templates: A rumor of a hidden refinery is circulating among miners.
Some pilots say the scrap metal is being diverted to an unknown location.
rumor_trail.payoff: Unlocks a secret route to a high-value salvage site.

horizon.gate_tease: The next gate leads toward the manufacturing heartlands.
horizon.new_system_reveal_rule: New systems are revealed only when a gate is successfully navigated.
horizon.future_pressure_tease: Rumors of an encroaching trade blockade.
horizon.future_ore_or_upgrade_tease: Advanced alloys and heavy-duty engine upgrades.

regeneration_trigger.description: When the refinery is stabilized, new trade routes are revealed.

rules.humor_rule: Use dry, cynical humor regarding ship maintenance and fuel costs.
rules.fallback: If a quest objective is unclear, default to a contract from Kaelen.

story_questions_for_future_generation: What is the scale of the rest of universe?
Why is there no central government?
How does a new faction emerge from the collapse?
Who will be told to abandon their ship first?
Where can the player find a relic of pre-spaceflight?
